title: list_owner_assignments input
description: Owner assignments across the portfolio for the owners and people page: by person (principalObjectId, ended ones too with state all), by owner role, by application or portfolio. leaversOnly keeps holders with a recorded leave date, or whom the last owner check found disabled or deleted. coverage counts, per owner role, the registered applications in scope with a holder, a deputy, or a gap. The owner gap list itself is get_portfolio_summary with includeOwnerGaps. Writes nothing.

portfolioId.description: Only applications in this portfolio or below it.

leaversOnly.description: True keeps only holders with a leave date or a disabled or deleted directory state. Platform admin only, as run_owner_check: anyone else is answered not_authorized.
